extra_vocab.zh: 無心之過、非故意的錯誤
extra_vocab.en: mistakes that a person makes without meaning to do anything wrong
extra_vocab.note: 常出現在公司規定或政策裡，表示員工因疏忽或誤會而犯的錯不會被處罰，用來和故意違規、欺騙區分開來。語氣善意、偏正式，常與 will not be penalized 搭配。
extra_vocab.pattern: not be penalized for + honest mistakes (in + N)
extra_vocab.grammar_note: honest mistake 的 honest 是「非故意、沒有惡意」，不是「誠實」；penalize 要用 be penalized for + 名詞或 V-ing。

examples.en: Everyone makes honest mistakes, so please report errors as early as possible.
examples.zh: 每個人都會犯無心之過，所以請盡早回報錯誤。

examples.en: The manager explained that honest mistakes will not affect your performance review.
examples.zh: 經理說明，無心之過不會影響你的績效考核。

examples.en: We understand that honest mistakes happen, and we will correct your bill today.
examples.zh: 我們了解無心之過難免，今天就會更正您的帳單。

examples.en: The auditor found only honest mistakes, not any attempt to hide money.
examples.zh: 稽核員只發現無心的錯誤，沒有發現隱藏金錢的企圖。

similar.diff: innocent mistake 意思幾乎相同，更強調當事人無辜、不知情，法律或賠償情境常見。

example.en: The overcharge was an innocent mistake, and we have refunded it.
example.zh: 多收費用是無心的錯誤，我們已經退款了。

similar.diff: human error 是不可數的說法，用來說明原因是人為失誤，不特別強調有沒有惡意。

example.en: The delay was caused by human error in the data entry.
example.zh: 這次延誤是資料輸入的人為失誤造成的。

confusable.diff: careless mistakes 是因為粗心大意造成，當事人可能要負責；honest mistakes 強調沒有惡意，通常可以被原諒。

example.en: Careless mistakes in the report may damage our reputation with clients.
example.zh: 報告中的粗心錯誤可能會損害我們在客戶心中的信譽。
